sentences.text: Ibu kantin menyiapkan puding cokelat untuk menyambut Dimas di hari pertamanya.
sentences.en: The canteen lady made a chocolate pudding to welcome Dimas on his first day.
sentences.ko: 구내식당 아주머니가 첫날 디마스를 맞이하려고 초콜릿 푸딩을 준비했어요.

sentences.text: Putri membeli puding mangga di kafe dekat gerbang keberangkatan.
sentences.en: Putri bought a mango pudding at a café near the departure gate.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 출국 게이트 근처 카페에서 망고 푸딩을 샀어요.

sentences.text: Pagi pertama kerja, Dimas sudah mengalami kesialan kecil: kopinya tumpah ke kemeja.
sentences.en: On his first morning at work, Dimas already had a bit of bad luck: his coffee spilled on his shirt.
sentences.ko: 출근 첫날 아침부터 디마스는 작은 불운을 겪었어요. 커피가 셔츠에 쏟아졌거든요.

sentences.text: Koper rusak dan penerbangan tertunda, kesialan Putri hari itu seperti tidak ada habisnya.
sentences.en: A broken suitcase and a delayed flight: Putri's bad luck that day seemed endless.
sentences.ko: 가방은 망가지고 비행기는 늦어지고, 그날 푸트리의 불운은 끝이 없는 것 같았어요.

sentences.text: Dimas masih sungkan bertanya kepada atasannya soal jam istirahat.
sentences.en: Dimas still felt too shy to ask his boss about break times.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 아직 상사에게 쉬는 시간을 묻기가 어색했어요.

sentences.text: Putri sungkan membangunkan penumpang di sebelahnya untuk pergi ke toilet.
sentences.en: Putri felt awkward waking the passenger next to her to go to the toilet.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 화장실에 가려고 옆 승객을 깨우기가 미안했어요.

sentences.text: Rekan kerja Dimas bercerita tentang kesengsaraan naik kereta yang penuh setiap pagi.
sentences.en: Dimas's coworker talked about the misery of riding a packed train every morning.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 동료는 매일 아침 꽉 찬 기차를 타는 고생을 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Bagi Putri, menunggu delapan jam di bandara terasa seperti kesengsaraan.
sentences.en: For Putri, waiting eight hours at the airport felt like misery.
sentences.ko: 푸트리에게 공항에서 여덟 시간을 기다리는 건 고역 같았어요.

sentences.text: Dimas sempat dilanda kepanikan saat kartu aksesnya tidak bisa dipakai.
sentences.en: Dimas briefly panicked when his access card didn't work.
sentences.ko: 출입 카드가 안 돼서 디마스는 잠깐 당황했어요.

sentences.text: Terjadi kepanikan kecil ketika paspor Putri tidak ada di tasnya.
sentences.en: There was a small panic when Putri's passport wasn't in her bag.
sentences.ko: 푸트리의 여권이 가방에 없자 작은 소동이 일어났어요.

sentences.text: Di pantri kantor, Dimas melihat rak penuh bumbu milik para karyawan.
sentences.en: In the office pantry, Dimas saw a shelf full of the employees' spices.
sentences.ko: 사무실 탕비실에서 디마스는 직원들의 양념으로 가득한 선반을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Petugas bea cukai memeriksa bumbu rendang yang dibawa Putri.
sentences.en: The customs officer checked the rendang spice paste Putri had brought.
sentences.ko: 세관 직원이 푸트리가 가져온 른당 양념을 검사했어요.

sentences.text: Ibu Dimas menelepon dan berpesan agar Dimas tetap tegar kalau hari pertamanya berat.
sentences.en: Dimas's mother called and told him to stay strong if his first day was hard.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 엄마는 전화해서 첫날이 힘들어도 꿋꿋하게 버티라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Putri berusaha tegar saat melambaikan tangan kepada orang tuanya di pintu keberangkatan.
sentences.en: Putri tried to stay strong as she waved to her parents at the departure door.
sentences.ko: 출국장 문에서 부모님께 손을 흔들며 푸트리는 꿋꿋하려고 애썼어요.

sentences.text: Kantor baru Dimas ada di pabrik roti, jadi sore itu bajunya penuh tepung.
sentences.en: Dimas's new office is in a bread factory, so that afternoon his clothes were covered in flour.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 새 사무실은 빵 공장에 있어서 그날 오후 옷이 밀가루투성이였어요.

sentences.text: Petugas bertanya tentang bubuk putih di koper Putri, yang ternyata hanya tepung kue.
sentences.en: The officer asked about the white powder in Putri's suitcase, which turned out to be just cake flour.
sentences.ko: 직원이 푸트리 가방 속 흰 가루를 물었는데, 알고 보니 케이크용 밀가루였어요.

sentences.text: Wajah Dimas tidak lagi murung setelah rekan-rekannya mengajaknya makan siang bersama.
sentences.en: Dimas no longer looked gloomy after his coworkers invited him to lunch.
sentences.ko: 동료들이 점심을 같이 먹자고 하자 디마스의 얼굴은 더 이상 우울하지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Putri melihat seorang anak kecil murung di ruang tunggu karena pesawatnya terlambat.
sentences.en: Putri saw a little child sulking in the waiting room because the plane was late.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 비행기가 늦어서 대기실에서 시무룩한 어린아이를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Rekan-rekan Dimas diam-diam bergosip soal kisah asmara di lantai tiga.
sentences.en: Dimas's coworkers quietly gossiped about a romance on the third floor.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 동료들은 삼 층의 연애 이야기를 몰래 수군거렸어요.

sentences.text: Sambil menunggu, Putri membaca novel asmara yang dibelinya di toko buku bandara.
sentences.en: While waiting, Putri read a romance novel she had bought at the airport bookshop.
sentences.ko: 기다리는 동안 푸트리는 공항 서점에서 산 연애 소설을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Meja Dimas masih kosong tanpa hiasan apa pun.
sentences.en: Dimas's desk was still bare, without any decorations.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 책상은 아직 장식 하나 없이 텅 비어 있었어요.

sentences.text: Putri membeli hiasan dinding kecil sebagai oleh-oleh untuk ibunya.
sentences.en: Putri bought a small wall decoration as a souvenir for her mother.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 엄마에게 줄 선물로 작은 벽 장식을 샀어요.

sentences.text: Ibu kantin sedang menggoreng tempe ketika Dimas datang untuk makan siang.
sentences.en: The canteen lady was frying tempeh when Dimas came for lunch.
sentences.ko: 디마스가 점심을 먹으러 왔을 때 식당 아주머니는 템페를 튀기고 있었어요.

sentences.text: Bau orang menggoreng kentang di restoran cepat saji tercium sampai ke kursi Putri.
sentences.en: The smell of fries being cooked at the fast-food restaurant reached Putri's seat.
sentences.ko: 패스트푸드점에서 감자 튀기는 냄새가 푸트리의 자리까지 풍겼어요.

sentences.text: Yang mengherankan bagi Dimas, hampir semua orang di kantor itu memakai sandal.
sentences.en: What surprised Dimas was that almost everyone in that office wore sandals.
sentences.ko: 디마스가 놀란 건 그 사무실 사람들이 거의 다 샌들을 신는다는 거였어요.

sentences.text: Antrean imigrasi kosong pagi itu, hal yang cukup mengherankan bagi Putri.
sentences.en: The immigration queue was empty that morning, which Putri found rather surprising.
sentences.ko: 그날 아침 출입국 심사 줄이 텅 비어 있어서 푸트리는 꽤 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Dimas tiba di lobi tepat saat pergantian sif satpam.
sentences.en: Dimas arrived in the lobby just as the security guards were changing shifts.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 경비원 교대 시간에 딱 맞춰 로비에 도착했어요.

sentences.text: Putri terbang menjelang pergantian tahun, saat bandara sedang ramai sekali.
sentences.en: Putri flew just before the turn of the year, when the airport was extremely busy.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 공항이 몹시 붐비는 연말연시 직전에 비행기를 탔어요.

sentences.text: Telepon di meja Dimas berdering terus-terusan sepanjang pagi.
sentences.en: The phone on Dimas's desk kept ringing all morning.
sentences.ko: 디마스 책상의 전화가 아침 내내 계속 울렸어요.

sentences.text: Pengeras suara terus-terusan memanggil penumpang yang belum naik, dan Putri mulai cemas.
sentences.en: The loudspeaker kept calling passengers who hadn't boarded, and Putri started to worry.
sentences.ko: 스피커가 아직 탑승하지 않은 승객을 계속 불러서 푸트리는 불안해지기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Atasan Dimas bilang ia akan cuti seminggu untuk menikahkan anak sulungnya.
sentences.en: Dimas's boss said she would take a week off to marry off her eldest child.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 상사는 큰아이를 결혼시키려고 일주일 휴가를 낸다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Putri terbang pulang karena orang tuanya akan menikahkan kakaknya.
sentences.en: Putri flew home because her parents were marrying off her older sister.
sentences.ko: 부모님이 언니를 결혼시키셔서 푸트리는 비행기를 타고 집에 갔어요.

sentences.text: Rapat pertama Dimas terasa sangat intelektual dan penuh istilah asing.
sentences.en: Dimas's first meeting felt very intellectual and full of foreign terms.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 첫 회의는 아주 지적이고 낯선 용어로 가득했어요.

sentences.text: Pria di sebelah Putri tampak sangat intelektual dengan kacamata dan buku filsafatnya.
sentences.en: The man next to Putri looked very intellectual with his glasses and philosophy book.
sentences.ko: 푸트리 옆의 남자는 안경과 철학책 때문에 아주 지적으로 보였어요.

sentences.text: Pak Budi memberi Dimas beberapa saran taktis untuk menghadapi klien yang cerewet.
sentences.en: Mr. Budi gave Dimas some tactical advice for dealing with fussy clients.
sentences.ko: 부디 씨는 까다로운 고객을 상대하는 요령을 디마스에게 몇 가지 알려 줬어요.

sentences.text: Putri mengambil langkah taktis dengan check-in daring supaya tidak perlu antre.
sentences.en: Putri made a tactical move by checking in online so she wouldn't have to queue.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 줄을 서지 않으려고 온라인 체크인을 하는 요령을 부렸어요.

sentences.text: Kebiasaan tidur Dimas berubah drastis sejak ia mulai kerja kantoran.
sentences.en: Dimas's sleeping habits changed drastically once he started an office job.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 잠버릇은 회사에 다니기 시작하면서 확 바뀌었어요.

sentences.text: Harga tiket Putri naik drastis karena ia memesan di menit terakhir.
sentences.en: Putri's ticket price rose drastically because she booked at the last minute.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 막판에 예약해서 표값이 크게 올랐어요.

sentences.text: Sebagai karyawan baru, Dimas mendapat meja terkecil di pojok ruangan.
sentences.en: As the new employee, Dimas got the smallest desk in the corner of the room.
sentences.ko: 신입이라 디마스는 방구석의 가장 작은 책상을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Putri memilih koper terkecil yang masih muat di kabin.
sentences.en: Putri chose the smallest suitcase that would still fit in the cabin.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 기내에 들어가는 가장 작은 가방을 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Dimas spontan tertawa saat atasannya melucu di tengah rapat.
sentences.en: Dimas laughed spontaneously when his boss cracked a joke in the middle of the meeting.
sentences.ko: 상사가 회의 중에 농담을 하자 디마스는 저도 모르게 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Perjalanan Putri kali ini sangat spontan karena tiketnya baru dibeli tadi malam.
sentences.en: Putri's trip this time was very spontaneous, since she only bought the ticket last night.
sentences.ko: 이번 푸트리의 여행은 표를 어젯밤에야 사서 아주 즉흥적이었어요.

sentences.text: Suara Dimas menggema di ruang rapat yang masih kosong.
sentences.en: Dimas's voice echoed in the still-empty meeting room.
sentences.ko: 아직 텅 빈 회의실에 디마스의 목소리가 울렸어요.

sentences.text: Pengumuman keberangkatan menggema di seluruh terminal saat Putri tiba.
sentences.en: The departure announcement echoed through the whole terminal as Putri arrived.
sentences.ko: 푸트리가 도착했을 때 출발 안내 방송이 터미널 전체에 울려 퍼졌어요.

sentences.text: Bu Ratna, atasan Dimas, terkenal menuntut kesempurnaan dalam setiap laporan.
sentences.en: Ms. Ratna, Dimas's boss, is known for demanding perfection in every report.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 상사 라트나 씨는 모든 보고서에 완벽함을 요구하기로 유명해요.

sentences.text: Putri mengagumi kesempurnaan desain atap terminal yang baru.
sentences.en: Putri admired the perfection of the new terminal's roof design.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 새 터미널 지붕 디자인의 완벽함에 감탄했어요.

sentences.text: Tangan Dimas tergores ujung lemari arsip yang tajam.
sentences.en: Dimas's hand got scratched on the sharp corner of the filing cabinet.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 손이 서류함의 날카로운 모서리에 긁혔어요.

sentences.text: Koper baru Putri tergores saat keluar dari ban bagasi.
sentences.en: Putri's new suitcase got scratched as it came off the baggage belt.
sentences.ko: 푸트리의 새 가방이 수하물 벨트에서 나오다가 긁혔어요.

sentences.text: Di rapat pertama, Dimas belum berani mengekspresikan pendapatnya.
sentences.en: At his first meeting, Dimas didn't yet dare to express his opinion.
sentences.ko: 첫 회의에서 디마스는 아직 자기 의견을 말할 용기가 없었어요.

sentences.text: Putri sulit mengekspresikan rasa lega setelah pesawatnya mendarat dengan selamat.
sentences.en: Putri found it hard to express her relief after her plane landed safely.
sentences.ko: 비행기가 무사히 착륙하자 푸트리는 안도감을 말로 표현하기 어려웠어요.

sentences.text: Dimas menarik tuas di bawah kursi supaya posisi duduknya lebih tinggi.
sentences.en: Dimas pulled the lever under the chair to raise his seat.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 의자 아래 레버를 당겨 앉는 높이를 올렸어요.

sentences.text: Putri menekan tuas troli supaya rodanya bisa bergerak.
sentences.en: Putri pressed the trolley's lever so the wheels could move.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 바퀴가 움직이도록 카트의 레버를 눌렀어요.

sentences.text: Di kantor hukum itu, Dimas ikut menyiapkan berkas untuk warga yang ingin menggugat sebuah pabrik.
sentences.en: At the law firm, Dimas helped prepare files for residents who wanted to sue a factory.
sentences.ko: 그 법률 사무소에서 디마스는 공장을 고소하려는 주민들의 서류 준비를 도왔어요.

sentences.text: Putri mendengar seorang penumpang mengancam akan menggugat maskapai karena bagasinya hilang.
sentences.en: Putri heard a passenger threaten to sue the airline because his luggage was lost.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 한 승객이 짐을 잃어버렸다며 항공사를 고소하겠다고 하는 걸 들었어요.

sentences.text: Dimas mencopot label harga yang masih menempel di kursi barunya.
sentences.en: Dimas peeled off the price tag still stuck to his new chair.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 새 의자에 아직 붙어 있던 가격표를 떼어 냈어요.

sentences.text: Di pemeriksaan keamanan, Putri harus mencopot ikat pinggang dan jam tangannya.
sentences.en: At the security check, Putri had to take off her belt and watch.
sentences.ko: 보안 검색대에서 푸트리는 벨트와 손목시계를 풀어야 했어요.

sentences.text: Rekan kerja Dimas menyodorkan beberapa keping biskuit sebagai ucapan selamat datang.
sentences.en: Dimas's coworker held out a few biscuits as a welcome.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 동료가 환영 인사로 비스킷 몇 조각을 내밀었어요.

sentences.text: Putri menemukan beberapa keping uang logam asing di saku jaketnya.
sentences.en: Putri found a few foreign coins in her jacket pocket.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 재킷 주머니에서 외국 동전 몇 개를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Dimas mengencangkan sekrup monitornya yang goyang.
sentences.en: Dimas tightened the screw on his wobbly monitor.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 흔들리는 모니터의 나사를 조였어요.

sentences.text: Roda koper Putri hampir lepas karena satu sekrup kendur.
sentences.en: A wheel on Putri's suitcase almost came off because one screw was loose.
sentences.ko: 나사 하나가 헐거워져서 푸트리의 가방 바퀴가 빠질 뻔했어요.

sentences.text: Pagi itu Dimas melompati genangan air di depan gedung kantor.
sentences.en: That morning Dimas jumped over a puddle in front of the office building.
sentences.ko: 그날 아침 디마스는 회사 건물 앞 물웅덩이를 뛰어넘었어요.

sentences.text: Seorang anak melompati tali pembatas antrean di depan Putri.
sentences.en: A child jumped over the queue rope in front of Putri.
sentences.ko: 한 아이가 푸트리 앞의 줄 서기용 줄을 뛰어넘었어요.

sentences.text: Pak Budi merangkul Dimas dan mengenalkannya kepada seluruh tim.
sentences.en: Mr. Budi put his arm around Dimas and introduced him to the whole team.
sentences.ko: 부디 씨는 디마스의 어깨를 감싸며 팀 전체에 소개했어요.

sentences.text: Di pintu kedatangan, ayah Putri langsung merangkul putrinya erat-erat.
sentences.en: At the arrivals door, Putri's father immediately hugged his daughter tight.
sentences.ko: 입국장 문에서 푸트리의 아빠는 딸을 바로 꼭 끌어안았어요.

sentences.ko: 디마스는 새 노트북에 회사 앱을 잔뜩 내려받아야 했어요.

sentences.text: Putri mengunduh pas naik pesawat ke ponselnya sebelum berangkat ke bandara.

sentences.ko: 푸트리는 공항에 가기 전에 탑승권을 휴대폰에 내려받았어요.

sentences.text: Semua perabotan di kantor baru Dimas masih terbungkus plastik.

sentences.ko: 디마스의 새 사무실 가구는 전부 아직 비닐에 싸여 있었어요.

sentences.text: Ruang tunggu itu baru direnovasi, dan Putri suka perabotan kayunya yang empuk.

sentences.ko: 그 대기실은 새로 고쳐서 푸트리는 푹신한 나무 가구가 마음에 들었어요.

sentences.text: Kata Pak Budi, lift kantor seringkali macet pada jam sibuk.
sentences.en: According to Mr. Budi, the office lift often gets stuck at rush hour.
sentences.ko: 부디 씨 말로는 회사 엘리베이터가 붐비는 시간에 자주 멈춘대요.

sentences.text: Putri seringkali lupa mengosongkan botol minumnya sebelum pemeriksaan keamanan.
sentences.en: Putri often forgets to empty her water bottle before the security check.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 보안 검색 전에 물병 비우는 걸 자주 잊어요.

sentences.text: Di belakang gedung ada gubuk kecil tempat satpam beristirahat, kata Pak Budi kepada Dimas.
sentences.en: Behind the building there's a small hut where the guards rest, Mr. Budi told Dimas.
sentences.ko: 건물 뒤에 경비원들이 쉬는 작은 오두막이 있다고 부디 씨가 디마스에게 말했어요.

sentences.text: Dari jendela pesawat, Putri melihat sebuah gubuk petani di pinggir sawah.
sentences.en: From the plane window, Putri saw a farmer's hut at the edge of a rice field.
sentences.ko: 비행기 창문으로 푸트리는 논 가장자리의 농부 오두막을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Dimas baru selesai pindahan ke kos dekat kantor seminggu sebelumnya.
sentences.en: Dimas had only finished moving into a boarding room near the office the week before.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 일주일 전에야 회사 근처 하숙방으로 이사를 마쳤어요.

sentences.text: Koper Putri berat sekali karena ia sedang pindahan ke kota lain.
sentences.en: Putri's suitcase was very heavy because she was moving to another city.
sentences.ko: 다른 도시로 이사하는 중이라 푸트리의 가방은 아주 무거웠어요.

sentences.text: Ibu kantin mengiris semangka untuk Dimas dan teman-teman barunya.
sentences.en: The canteen lady sliced a watermelon for Dimas and his new friends.
sentences.ko: 식당 아주머니가 디마스와 새 동료들을 위해 수박을 썰어 줬어요.

sentences.text: Di lounge bandara, seorang koki mengiris daging panggang untuk Putri.
sentences.en: In the airport lounge, a chef sliced roast meat for Putri.
sentences.ko: 공항 라운지에서 요리사가 푸트리에게 구운 고기를 썰어 줬어요.

sentences.text: Dimas menyembunyikan kekecewaan saat tahu gajinya baru cair bulan depan.
sentences.en: Dimas hid his disappointment when he found out his salary wouldn't be paid until next month.
sentences.ko: 월급이 다음 달에야 나온다는 걸 알고 디마스는 실망을 감췄어요.

sentences.text: Putri tidak bisa menutupi kekecewaan saat penerbangannya dibatalkan.
sentences.en: Putri couldn't hide her disappointment when her flight was cancelled.
sentences.ko: 항공편이 취소되자 푸트리는 실망을 감추지 못했어요.

sentences.text: Ada penundaan rapat perkenalan karena atasan Dimas terjebak macet.
sentences.en: The introduction meeting was postponed because Dimas's boss was stuck in traffic.
sentences.ko: 디마스의 상사가 차가 막혀서 소개 회의가 미뤄졌어요.

sentences.text: Maskapai meminta maaf kepada Putri dan penumpang lain atas penundaan dua jam.
sentences.en: The airline apologized to Putri and the other passengers for the two-hour delay.
sentences.ko: 항공사는 두 시간 지연에 대해 푸트리와 다른 승객들에게 사과했어요.
